verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a built-in AI assistant: AI Chats can take blocks or notes as context, and the assistant can plan multi-step work and propose creates and updates for the user to approve. It also offers task-like features such as property auto-fill and one-click image analysis, and the pricing page lists the AI assistant as a feature. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of delegation quality, detail on the range of actions the assistant can take, and no autonomous execution (changes require user approval).
